BELIEVER-DIVINITY_TEST_CARD.title: Divinity Test
BELIEVER-OMNISCIENCE_CARD.title: Omniscience
BELIEVER-OMNISCIENCE_CARD.description:
Only playable at 7 Divinity.
Consume 7 Divinity: draw 3 cards, remove all debuffs, gain all unlocked Miracles and make cards cost 0. Take no HP loss until the enemy's turn ends.
BELIEVER-DEV_MIRACLE_TEST_CARD.title: Test Miracle
BELIEVER-LET_THERE_BE_LIGHT.title: Let There Be Light
BELIEVER-LET_THERE_BE_LIGHT.description:
Deal 30 damage to ALL enemies.
Apply 2 Vulnerable.
BELIEVER-GENESIS.title: Genesis
BELIEVER-GENESIS.description:
Extend Omniscience by 1 player turn.
Can only happen once per Omniscience.
BELIEVER-FOUR_HORSEMEN.title: Four Horsemen
BELIEVER-FOUR_HORSEMEN.description:
Conquest: Deal 15 damage to ALL enemies and apply 2 Vulnerable.
War: Deal 20 damage to ALL enemies.
Famine: Deal 15 damage to ALL enemies and apply 2 Weak.
Death: Deal 45 damage to the enemy with the lowest HP.
BELIEVER-PARTING_OF_THE_RED_SEA.title: Parting of the Red Sea
BELIEVER-PARTING_OF_THE_RED_SEA.descript:
Deal 30 damage to ALL enemies.
Gain 40 Block. Retain your Block next turn.
BELIEVER-TEN_PLAGUES.title: Ten Plagues
BELIEVER-TEN_PLAGUES.description: Deal 6 damage to a random enemy 10 times.
BELIEVER-FALL_OF_JERICHO.title: Fall of Jericho
BELIEVER-FALL_OF_JERICHO.description:
Remove Block from ALL enemies.
Deal 25 damage to ALL enemies.
Apply 2 Vulnerable.
BELIEVER-JUDGMENT_OF_FIRE.title: Judgment of Fire
BELIEVER-JUDGMENT_OF_FIRE.description:
Deal 70 damage to an enemy.
If this kills it, deal 25 damage to ALL other enemies.
BELIEVER-SEVEN_SEALS.title: Seven Seals of the Lamb
BELIEVER-SEVEN_SEALS.description:
Deal 7 damage to ALL enemies 7 times.
Then deal 15 damage to ALL enemies.
BELIEVER-FIVE_LOAVES_AND_TWO_FISH.title: Five Loaves and Two Fish
BELIEVER-FIVE_LOAVES_AND_TWO_FISH.descri:
Choose an ordinary card in your hand.
Add 3 temporary copies of it to your hand. They cost 0 and disappear at the end of your turn.
BELIEVER-LAZARUS_RISES.title: Lazarus Rises
BELIEVER-LAZARUS_RISES.description:
Choose up to 3 ordinary cards from your exhaust pile.
Put them into your hand. Their cost is 0 this turn.
BELIEVER-LAZARUS_RISES.selectionScreenPr: Choose up to 3 cards to return to your hand.
BELIEVER-LORD_OF_HOSTS.title: Lord of Hosts
BELIEVER-LORD_OF_HOSTS.description:
This turn, whenever you play an ordinary card, deal 5 damage to ALL enemies.
Triggers up to 8 times.
BELIEVER-WHITE_THRONE_JUDGMENT.title: White Throne Judgment
BELIEVER-WHITE_THRONE_JUDGMENT.descripti:
Deal 35 damage to ALL enemies.
Bosses take 40 more damage.
After damage, non-boss enemies below 30% HP are killed.
BELIEVER-STRIKE_BELIEVER.title: Strike
BELIEVER-HEAVY_STRIKE.title: Heavy Strike
BELIEVER-TRIPLE_SLASH.title: Triple Slash
BELIEVER-SWEEP.title: Sweep
BELIEVER-DEFEND_BELIEVER.title: Defend
BELIEVER-STEADFAST.title: Steadfast
BELIEVER-STEADFAST.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
If you have at least 3 Divinity, gain {ExtraBlock:diff()} additional Block.
BELIEVER-FOCUS.title: Focus
BELIEVER-SILENT_PRAYER.title: Silent Prayer
BELIEVER-FAITH_OFFERING.title: Faith Offering
BELIEVER-INNER_CALM.title: Inner Calm
BELIEVER-DEDICATION.title: Dedication
BELIEVER-DEDICATION.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
If you have at least 3 Divinity, gain {ExtraBlock:diff()} additional Block.
BELIEVER-PURIFICATION.title: Purification
BELIEVER-PURIFICATION.description:
Remove 1 removable debuff from yourself.
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
BELIEVER-PREPARATION.title: Preparation
BELIEVER-PRAYER.title: Prayer
BELIEVER-PRAYER.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
If you have at least 3 Divinity, gain {Divinity:diff()} Divinity.
BELIEVER-DIVINE_GRACE.title: Divine Grace
BELIEVER-DIVINE_GRACE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
If you have at least 1 Divinity, gain {ExtraBlock:diff()} additional Block.
BELIEVER-COMPOSURE.title: Composure
BELIEVER-COMPOSURE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
If you have 0 Divinity, gain {Divinity:diff()} Divinity.
BELIEVER-ARMOR_BREAK.title: Armor Break
BELIEVER-ARMOR_BREAK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target has Block, deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage.
BELIEVER-PURSUIT.title: Pursuit
BELIEVER-PURSUIT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you have gained Divinity this turn, deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage.
BELIEVER-PIERCE.title: Pierce
BELIEVER-SEVERING_STRIKE.title: Severing Strike
BELIEVER-SEVERING_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target is at or below 50% HP, deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage.
BELIEVER-BEACON.title: Beacon
BELIEVER-BEACON.description: The first time you gain Divinity each turn, gain {Block:diff()} Block.
BELIEVER-GUARDIAN.title: Guardian
BELIEVER-GUARDIAN.description: At the end of each turn, if you have at least 1 Divinity, gain {Block:diff()} Block.
BELIEVER-BESTOW.title: Bestow
BELIEVER-BESTOW.description: The first two times you gain Divinity each turn, gain {Block:diff()} Block each.
BELIEVER-CONCENTRATION.title: Concentration
BELIEVER-CONCENTRATION.description: The first time you play a Skill each turn, gain {Divinity:diff()} Divinity.
BELIEVER-DIVINE_PUNISHMENT.title: Divine Punishment
BELIEVER-DIVINE_PUNISHMENT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to an enemy.
If you have at least 4 Divinity, deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
BELIEVER-SACRED_JUDGMENT.title: Sacred Judgment
BELIEVER-SACRED_JUDGMENT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you have at least 5 Divinity, deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage.
BELIEVER-VERDICT.title: Verdict
BELIEVER-VERDICT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
For each debuff on the target, deal {PerDebuff:diff()} additional damage (up to {MaxExtra:diff()}).
BELIEVER-CHAIN.title: Chain
BELIEVER-FINALITY.title: Finality
BELIEVER-FINALITY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target is at or below 50% HP, deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage.
BELIEVER-FIRE_OFFERING.title: Fire Offering
BELIEVER-PRICE.title: Price
BELIEVER-PRICE.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
If you have at least 4 Divinity, gain 1 temporary Energy.
BELIEVER-SACRIFICE.title: Sacrifice
BELIEVER-SACRIFICE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
If you have at least 5 Divinity, deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage to ALL enemies.
BELIEVER-ABSOLUTION.title: Absolution
BELIEVER-ABSOLUTION.description:
Remove ALL removable debuffs from yourself.
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
BELIEVER-PROPHECY.title: Prophecy
BELIEVER-PROPHECY.description: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards, discard 1 card, gain 1 Divinity.
BELIEVER-ECHO.title: Echo
BELIEVER-ECHO.description: This turn, the next Attack card deals extra damage equal to {Percent:diff()}% of its original damage.
BELIEVER-LIMIT_BREAK.title: Limit Break
BELIEVER-LIMIT_BREAK.description:
Gain 1 temporary Energy.
If you have at least 5 Divinity, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
BELIEVER-THEOPHANY.title: Theophany
BELIEVER-THEOPHANY.description:
Gain {Divinity:diff()} Divinity and {Block:diff()} Block.
Draw 1 card.
BELIEVER-COVENANT.title: Covenant
BELIEVER-COVENANT.description:
The first time you gain Divinity each turn, gain 1 additional Divinity.
When upgraded, that trigger also grants 3 Block.
BELIEVER-MANIFESTATION.title: Manifestation
BELIEVER-MANIFESTATION.description: Whenever you enter Omniscience, draw {Cards:diff()} additional cards.
BELIEVER-CHANNEL.title: Channel
BELIEVER-CHANNEL.description:
Every {Cards:diff()} cards you play each turn, gain 1 Block and draw 1 card.
Up to 3 times per turn.
